biggest_catch: The $200/month is a ceiling, not a promise — actual pay per campaign is set in the contract and can be withheld if you miss mileage requirements.
catches: Advertised as 'up to $200 more per month' — exact pay is spelled out in each campaign contract you accept.
You must meet campaign mileage minimums (e.g. 30 miles/day or 450-600/month on some landing pages) or pay can be withheld.
Campaign availability is limited, especially outside major metros.
The app tracks your GPS location for advertisers.

notes: Lane rule: framed as earnings for driving you already do; do not drive extra miles to chase wrap pay. Acceptance and campaign availability are not guaranteed.
